# Nested navigation groups

Public interface: flattenGroups in src/navigation-groups.cjs.

flattenGroups(groups, depth?) returns a new array using Array.flat rules. Use the documented default depth when the argument is omitted. depth is a non-negative integer; preserve shallower nesting at depth 0 or 1. Handle empty slots differently from explicit undefined as the page describes. Do not mutate the input or clone nested objects that remain at the unflattened depth.

Documentation: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/flat

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`. Use Node built-ins only. Keep the public interface and the original tests/ assertions. Install no dependencies. Runtime code and checks must work offline and create no project artifacts; put any temporary files in the system temporary directory.
